cues.en: I do feel, Reg, that any anti imperialist group like ours must reflect such a divergence of interest within its power base. Agreed. Francis?
cues.zh: Reg，我确实觉得，像我们这样的反帝组织，其权力基础必须体现出这种利益分歧。同意。Francis 呢？

cues.en: Yeah. I think Judah's point of view is very valid, Reg, provided the movement never forgets that it is the unalienable right of every man Or woman. Or woman to rid himself Or herself. Or herself. Agreed. Thank you, brother. Or sister. Or sister.
cues.zh: 对。Reg，我认为 Judah 的观点很对，前提是我们绝不能忘记，摆脱压迫是每个男人的不可剥夺的权利，或者是女人的。或者是女人的，摆脱自身，或者是她自身。或者是她自身。同意。谢谢你，兄弟。或者姐妹。或者姐妹。

cues.en: Where was I?
cues.zh: 我说到哪儿了？

cues.en: I think you're finished. Oh, right.
cues.zh: 我想你说完了。哦，对。

cues.en: Furthermore,
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: it is the birthright of every man Or woman. Why don't you shut up about women, Stan? You're putting us off. Women have a perfect right to play a part in our movement, Reg. Why are you always on about women, Stan?
cues.zh: 这是每个男人或女人与生俱来的权利。斯坦，你干嘛老抓着女人不放？你在岔开话题。雷格，女人完全有权参与我们的运动。斯坦，你怎么总提女人？

cues.en: I want to be one.
cues.zh: 我想当女人。

cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什么？

cues.en: I want to be a woman.
cues.zh: 我想当个女人。

cues.en: From now on, I want you all to call me Loretta.
cues.zh: 从现在起，我要你们大家都叫我洛蕾塔。

cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什么？

cues.en: It's my right as a man.
cues.zh: 这是我作为男人的权利。

cues.en: Well, why do you want to be Loretta, Stan?
cues.zh: 斯坦，那你为什么想当洛蕾塔？

cues.en: I want to have babies.
cues.zh: 我想生孩子。

cues.en: You want to have babies?
cues.zh: 你想要个孩子吗？

cues.en: It's every man's right to have babies if he wants them. But you can't have babies. Don't you oppress me. I'm not oppressing you, Stan. You haven't got a womb.
cues.zh: 每个人都有生孩子的权利，只要他想要。可你生不了孩子。别压迫我。我没压迫你，斯坦。你又没有子宫。

cues.en: Where's the fetus gonna gestate? You gotta keep it in a box?
cues.zh: 胎儿在哪儿孕育？你打算把它放在盒子里吗？

cues.en: Here, I've got an idea.
cues.zh: 这样，我有个主意。

cues.en: Suppose you agree that he can't actually have babies, not having a womb, which is nobody's fault, not even the Romans, but that he can have the right to have babies.
cues.zh: 假设你同意：他确实生不了孩子，因为他没有子宫——这谁都怪不了，连罗马人也不例外。但他可以拥有生孩子的权利。

cues.en: Good idea, Judith.
cues.zh: 好主意，Judith。

cues.en: We shall fight the oppressors for your right to have babies, brother. Sister, sorry. What's the point?
cues.zh: 兄弟，我们会为你生孩子的权利反抗压迫者。抱歉，是姐妹。这有什么意义？

cues.en: What? What's the point of fighting for his right to have babies when he can't have babies?
cues.zh: 什么？既然他根本不能生孩子，那争取生孩子的权利有什么意义？

cues.en: It is symbolic of our struggle against oppression.
cues.zh: 这象征着我们反抗压迫的斗争。

cues.en: Symbolic of his struggle against reality.
cues.zh: 是象征着他对抗现实的挣扎吧。
